title: Intersectionality in Conversational AI Safety: How Bayesian Multilevel Models Help Understand Diverse Perceptions of Safety
reasoning: The paper investigates rater subjectivity and demographic intersectionality in the perception of 'safety' in human-chatbot conversations. While safety and fairness (bias) are ethical considerations in AI, the study focuses on statistical modeling of rater demographics rather than benchmarking or evaluating religion, spiritual traditions, or specific moral/theological systems.
